phase_name: Activate the literature extension, deploy, and verify byte identity

objectives.description: Re-confirm the literature key is still absent from .claude-extensions.json
Enumerate and record the activation blast radius from manifest.json
Activate literature via one-off headless manager.load call
Confirm registration active with populated installed_files
Verify byte identity for zotero-write.sh, zotero-read.sh, zotero-setup.sh, literature-ingest-online.sh
Reconcile README.md Deployment Status section with post-deploy reality
Run check-extension-docs.sh; fix in-territory literature findings

deviations.reason: The literature extension itself is fully clean after fixing two missing index-entries.json entries and three stale line_count values (all literature-owned, source-store-only fixes). The script's overall exit code remains 1 solely due to three pre-existing core-extension findings (two index-entries.json line_count mismatches, one missing index entry for context/standards/task-reference-exemptions.md), confirmed pre-existing via git status at dispatch start (agent-system/extensions/core/index-entries.json was already modified before this dispatch began). Fixing those would require editing agent-system/extensions/core/**, which this task's binding rules and Non-Goals section place out of territory.
